title.narrative: Food security in vulnerable communities in Lima, Peru through strengthened community kitchens & food recovery strategies

description.narrative: (1)18 "Ollas Comunes" (community kitchens) of Pachacamac (approx 1,476 people aged between 28 and 60, 90% of whom are women). (2) 5 Ollas Comunes of Villa María del Triunfo (587 people aged between 28 and 60, 90% of whom are women).(3) Network of Ollas Comunes in the greater Lima area (18 community leaders from the Board of Directors, aged between 28 and 60, 95% of whom are women).(4) Young activists from the south of Lima (100 people aged between 19 and 35, 60% of whom are women).Indirect target group: Network of the ‘Ollas Comunes’ of Pachacamac (3,680 people); Network of the ‘Ollas comunes’ of Villa María del Triunfo (1,761 people);20 markets (where food valorisation processes are introduced with Ollas Comunes); 8 farms (where food recovery processes are introduced with the help of Ollas Comunes).

In the aftermath of Covid-19 & global food crisis, 50% of the Peruvian population suffers food insecurity. Action from public/private entities is lagging w. inefficient & uncoordinated use of resources & high food waste volumes. The project strive to contribute to implementing innovative, sustainable & accountable proposals from the State, in coordination with the private sector & civil society,to combat the food crisis in the context of climate change. In particular, it will strengthen the role of the community kitchens to fight the food security crisis, including new strategies on food recovery. The project will be implemented in two districts in the south of Lima.

The overall objective is to contribute to mitigate climate change and the food crisis of food insecure communities in Peru with innovative sustainable food recovery initiatives.The project objective is to improve the availability and access to healthy food in the ollas communes (community kitchens) in two districts of southern, Lima with the recovery and transformation of food to reduce losses and waste.
